title: OA COMBAT PROCEDURES - the missile fire from horseback doctrine: the unmoving-horse freedom, the horsemanship gate, the halved rate of fire and the speed-based to-hit penalties
audit_comment: OA round sixty-nine (capture p. 219): the Combat Procedures - the missile fire from horseback doctrine - the unmoving-horse freedom, the horsemanship proficiency gate, the halved rate of fire with the speed-based to-hit penalties, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA COMBAT PROCEDURES, printed capture p. 219 - the mounted bowfire round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE DOCTRINE FRAME: the mounted bowman is an integral part of the armies and fighting styles of the Oriental lands, the warriors firing great longbows at a full gallop. THE STANDING-HORSE FREEDOM: any character can use a missile weapon from the back of an unmoving horse - no particular skill. THE HORSEMANSHIP GATE: firing from a moving horse requires the horsemanship proficiency, the bow needing two hands so the horse is guided with the knees; the DM can rule extremely rough ground forces the reins, preventing bowfire. THE RATE: horseback fire is half the normal rate - 2/1 becomes 1/1, 3/1 becomes 3/2 - with to-hit penalties based on the speed of the animal, listed on Table 67. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus

consts.name: divOAHorsebackRateDivisor
consts.comment: the rate of fire from horseback is half what the character is normally allowed - the halving divisor of the mounted shots (print capture p. 219)

consts.name: divOAExampleMountedShotsLow
consts.comment: the printed rate conversion - the 2/1 rate of fire becoming 1/1 from horseback, the halved shots of the low example (print capture p. 219)

consts.name: divOAExampleMountedNumHigh
consts.comment: the printed rate conversion numerator - the 3/1 rate of fire becoming 3/2 from horseback, the shots of the second example (print capture p. 219)

consts.name: divOAExampleMountedDenHigh
consts.comment: the printed rate conversion denominator - the 3/2 of the halved 3/1 rate, the rounds span of the second example (print capture p. 219)

consts.name: divOABowfireHandsRequired
consts.comment: the two-hands rule - firing the bow requires two hands, the mounted bowman with the horsemanship proficiency guiding the horse with his knees (print capture p. 219)

bools.name: divOAMountedBowmanDoctrine
bools.comment: the doctrine frame - the mounted bowman is an integral part of the armies and fighting styles of the Oriental lands, the warriors refining the art until they fire great longbows at a full gallop (print capture p. 219)

bools.name: divOAUnmovingHorseAnyCharacter
bools.comment: the unmoving-horse freedom - any character can use a missile weapon from the back of an unmoving horse, taking no particular skill (print capture p. 219)

bools.name: divOAMovingHorseNeedsHorsemanship
bools.comment: the horsemanship gate - when firing from the back of a moving horse, the character must have the horsemanship proficiency (print capture p. 219)

bools.name: divOAKneesGuidance
bools.comment: the knees-guidance clause - the bowfire requiring two hands forces the mounted character to guide the horse with his knees (print capture p. 219)

bools.name: divOADMRoughGroundBlocksBowfire
bools.comment: the DM rough-ground clause - the DM can rule that extremely rough areas of ground (rocky slopes, thick underbrush) require the character to handle the reins, preventing bowfire (print capture p. 219)

bools.name: divOASpeedBasedToHitPenalty
bools.comment: the speed-based penalties - the mounted character also suffers penalties on his chance to hit, based on the speed of the animal, listed on Table 67 (print capture p. 219)
